title: Loss of offsite power
goal: Show generator and battery outcomes following a loss of offsite power.

rubric.must: Loss of offsite power and its initiating frequency are visibly shown at the left.
The emergency-generator function visibly branches to restored-power and failed-generator paths.
The battery function visibly appears only after the generator failure path.
Generator restoration, battery-supported DC power, and loss of essential AC/DC power are visibly distinct outcomes.
Generator and battery success/failure probability labels are visible.
The generator-success path visibly terminates without proceeding to a battery branch.

ideal.notes: Independently authored against visual-eval/exemplars/eventtree/ideal.svg (sha256 064a513719ee), source sha256 d3591db5c9a7. Independent orthogonal event tree with success above failure, pruned wildcard branches, complementary probabilities, aligned outcome table, and independently multiplied sequence frequencies; their sum equals the initiating frequency. No invented severity classes. All 21 risk-batch targets were rasterised with Resvg and visually inspected individually on 2026-09-14; this drawing was accepted for geometry, label readability and semantic traceability.
